summary: BioNexus Gene Lab Corp filed an 8-K on October 5, 2026 covering a CogniAI Healthcare Licence and Strategic Collaboration Agreement with Ruanyun Edai Technology Inc. (Nasdaq: RYET). At closing, BioNexus will issue 410,000 common shares for a US$3.5 million licence and 150,000 shares in exchange for 500,000 RYET ordinary shares, alongside a 10% royalty on technology receipts. Closing remains subject to technology acceptance, due diligence, regulatory approvals and compliance, with a long-stop date of March 31, 2027 if not extended. This is a strategic licensing and collaboration arrangement, not a special-situation transaction, though the fixed-share consideration and pending closing warrant monitoring for potential overhang or deal-failure risk.
